firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently trained a raptor to respond to hand signals goes first. If no one has done that, choose the first player randomly.
clarifications: Give the first-player marker to the selected player. Place the other players' turn-order markers in clockwise order; starting coins increase from first to fourth player.
